title: my brain's memory usage
caption:
ran a memory profiler on my brain. no notes, just regret.

song lyrics from 2009: 31%. one awkward thing I said years ago: 27%,
replaying nightly. how to write a for loop in bash: 0%.
the task I actually opened my laptop for: 4% and falling.

what's taking up the most space in yours?

items: the task I opened my laptop for
